name: session-message-layer
description: Projects Concordia session events into a durable display-ready work stream, exposes cursor/read-state APIs and wire events, and owns lifecycle and retention integration.
cardTemplate: Summarise the session-message-layer domain: deterministic event projection, canonical message persistence, read cursors, REST/wire contracts, retention, and subscription ownership.
rationale: Projection, canonical-row update semantics, read cursors, and message event delivery change together as one user-visible session stream. Exact integration-file membership attributes this feature's bootstrap, schema, and API wiring without claiming unrelated directories.
